title: Degreewise affine base-change comparison and its canonical prime-localization square
statement: Let R,A,R',A' be commutative rings and let f:R→A, g:R→R', g':A→A', f':R'→A' be ring maps whose Spec square is cartesian [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-scheme]. Let K in D_QCoh(Spec A), K' in D_QCoh(Spec A') [def-pc-derived-category], and phi:L(g')^*K→K' [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Supply K-flat coordinates c for phi [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. For each integer i, write b for the canonical derived comparison followed by Rf'_*phi [def-pc-derived-base-change-map, def-pc-derived-direct-image], H for degree-i cohomology, and F for restriction of A'-modules to R' followed by tilde [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. There exist A'-modules U,V, an A'-linear map a:U→V, and isomorphisms eU:F(U)≅H(Lg^*Rf_*K), eV:F(V)≅H(Rf'_*K'), such that eU ∘ H(b)=F(a) ∘ eV (composition in diagram order). For every prime p of A', there exist additive equivalences from U_p,V_p [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] to the source and target of the canonical stalkComparison(c,p,i), making lV(a_p(x))=stalkComparison(c,p,i)(lU(x)) for all x. No invertibility condition on the stalk comparisons is assumed.

proof.text: Represent K and K′ by affine module complexes using [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence]. Compute affine pullback by [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde], direct image by restriction of scalars, and preserve quasi-coherent cohomology using [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh]. The canonical derived adjunction/counit construction [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] identifies the composite b with the module tensor comparison followed by the morphism induced by phi. In degree i, [lem-pc-affine-derived-base-change-comparison-map] gives its tensor-algebra action and linearity. Transport across the canonical tensor-product identification with A′. Let U,V,a be these actual cohomology modules and linear map. Exact tilde gives eU,eV and the commuting cohomology square.

At p in Spec A′ use the source localization identity of [lem-pc-affine-derived-base-change-comparison-map]. Exact localization [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-exact] commutes with target cohomology. Tilde stalks are module localizations [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-stalk-localization]. The affine tensor/pullback identification identifies the localized comparison with the canonical tensor-stalk comparison. For the supplied K-flat coordinates c, exact stalks applied to c.e and c.e′ induce the representative cohomology isomorphisms. Their compatibility follows from the derived tensor model universal counit equations [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] and c.represents [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Forget scalar actions to obtain the additive equivalences lU,lV; naturality gives lV(a_p x)=stalkComparison(c,p,i)(lU x).

lean.statement: theorem exists_affineBaseChangeCohomologyModel [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (R A R' A' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A'] (φf : R →+* A) (φg : R →+* R') (φg' : A →+* A') (φf' : R' →+* A') (sq : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg))) (K : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A))) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A)) K) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A'))) (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A')) K') (φ : (derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).obj K ⟶ K') (c : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) K K' φ) (i : ℤ) : let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars φf' ⋙ tilde.functor (.of R') let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of R')).toRingedSpace)) i let b := schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) sq.w K ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))).map φ ∃ (U V : ModuleCat.{u} A') (a : U ⟶ V) (eU : F.obj U ≅ H.obj ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg))).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf))).obj K))) (eV : F.obj V ≅ H.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))).obj K')), eU.hom ≫ H.map b = F.map a ≫ eV.hom ∧ ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A', let t := SingleComplexBaseChange.stalkComparison (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) sq c p i ∃ (lU : LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl U ≃+ (Arrow.mk t).left) (lV : LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl V ≃+ (Arrow.mk t).right), ∀ x, lV (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl a.hom x) = t (lU x)
